video_title: Cedric Maxwell: ‘I’m Pissed Off’ about Jaylen Brown | Cedric Maxwell Podcast

quotes.speaker: Cedric Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Maxwell's frustration with Jaylen Brown's departure from Boston
quotes.excerpt: That's what I guess really just frankly just pisses me off when I start thinking about Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: That's what I guess really just frankly just pisses me off when I start thinking about Jaylen Brown and Jalen Brunson, and just to hear some of the comments that have been made about him.

quotes.speaker: Gary Tanguay
quotes.summary_phrase: Concerns regarding team chemistry and contract motivations for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Are we worried about who's the number one? Are we worried about touches? Are we worried about playing time?

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Tanguay
text_blocks.text: How does the chemistry work? Are we worried about who's the number one? Are we worried about touches? Are we worried about playing time? Is there going to be disgruntled egos? Because if there isn't, I think sky's the limit. If there is, they're screwed.

text_blocks.speaker: Cedric Maxwell
text_blocks.text: Who's playing for a contract? Maxey might be the only one that's coming up, but Embiid, he's not playing for one.

quotes.speaker: Gary Tanguay
quotes.summary_phrase: The trade of Marcus Smart as a slight to Brad Stevens
quotes.excerpt: That's another bit slap to Brad Stevens because the fans were so pissed off when he traded Smart.
quotes.quote: That's another bit slap to Brad Stevens because the fans were so pissed off when he traded Smart. I mean, listen, I really respect and like Brad Stevens. I'm not going to say he couldn't sign him. He said he could not sign him. How is that possible?

quotes.speaker: Nick Gelso
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's usage rate and role in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: You just put a guy on the team that leads NBA history I think in usage rate with LeBron.
quotes.quote: I'm envisioning January after the dust settles and the honeymoon wears off. I'm looking at Jalen Brunson specifically and I'm going to see a guy that's relegated to the corner with no movement like we've seen him do over the years when Jayson Tatum kind of dominates the ball. You just put a guy on the team that leads NBA history I think in usage rate with LeBron.

quotes.speaker: Gary Tanguay
quotes.summary_phrase: Gary Tanguay's criticism of the new ownership group
quotes.excerpt: I'm concerned about this new ownership. I think they're fakers. I think they're going to be penny pinchers.
quotes.quote: I hated to see him go. I think it was strictly money. I'm concerned about this new ownership. I'm concerned about this new ownership, I think they're fakers. I think they're going to be penny pinchers, even though they spent billions of dollars, but that's another story for another time.

quotes.speaker: Cedric Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Maxwell on the parity in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: I believe that the NBA now is maybe even better for the average fan because anybody can win it now.
quotes.quote: I believe that the NBA now is maybe even better for the average fan because anybody can win it now. We haven't had anybody just to dominate the way we think, you know, we think about it was the Lakers and the Celtics and the Celtics and the Lakers and then it was the Pistons and then somebody. But right now in the last three or four years, what they've had three or four different championships.

quotes.speaker: Cedric Maxwell
quotes.summary_phrase: Marcus Smart's role in establishing a culture of toughness
quotes.excerpt: There was a guy called Marcus Smart. Marcus Smart, if you did anything to any of these guys, he was going to go right at you.
quotes.quote: There was a guy called Marcus Smart. Are you forgetting? Marcus Smart, if you did anything to any of these guys, he was going to go right at you. And what we've seen when Marcus left, Brown took over that mantle of being mean and nasty. And then some of that nastiness also went with Tatum. And you didn't see that. And that's the only way you're going to win championships, that your best players have to be a little nasty and dirty.
